The purpose of this portfolio piece is to create an interactive map showing UFO sightings by year. 


```{r load_data}

tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load('2023-06-20')

ufo_sightings <- tuesdata$`ufo_sightings`
places <- tuesdata$`places`
day_parts_map <- tuesdata$`day_parts_map`
```

```{r filter_data}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

ufo_data <- ufo_sightings %>%
  filter(country_code =="US")

ufo_data$reported_date_time_utc <- as.Date(ufo_data$reported_date_time_utc) 

print("Extract year")
ufo_data$year <- as.numeric(format(ufo_data$reported_date_time_utc,"%Y"))
ufo_data
```

```{r load_us_map_data}
library(ggplot2)

us_map <- map_data("usa")

head(us_map)
ggplot(us_map, aes(long, lat, group = group)) + 
  geom_polygon(color = "blue", fill = "grey")


us_states <- map_data("state")
head(us_states)

ggplot(us_states, aes(long, lat, group = group)) + 
  geom_polygon(color="blue", fill= "grey")

```


```{r count_sightings_by_year_and_region}
library(dplyr) 

count_ufo <- ufo_data %>% 
  group_by(year, state) %>% 
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = 'drop')

```

```{r ufo_sightings_animation}
library(dplyr)
library(usmap)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)

count_ufo$year <- as.factor(count_ufo$year)

count_ufo <- count_ufo %>% 
  filter(!is.na(year), 
         !is.na(count), 
         !is.na(state)
  )


animated_map <- plot_ly(
  data = count_ufo, 
  type = "choropleth", 
  locations = ~state, 
  z = ~count,
  color = ~count, 
  colors = "Blues", 
  locationmode = "USA-states", 
  frame = ~year, 
  text = ~paste(state, "<br>count: ", count), 
  hoverinfo = "text", 
  colorbar = list(title = "Count")
) %>% 
  layout(
    geo = list(
      scope = "usa", 
      projection = list(type = "albers usa"), 
      showlakes = TRUE, 
      lakecolor = "rgb(255, 255, 255)"
  ), 
  title = "United States UFO Sightings by Year"
  )

saveWidget(animated_map, "us_animated_map.html")

browseURL("us_animated_map.html")

```
